supplementary_figure_S9_mechanism_contra.note: Independent transcription of supplementary page 33 (rendered at 160, 300 and 600 dpi; its vector text layer carries every row label and annotation), cross-checked against Tables S14b (pp. 10-11), S14 (p. 10) and S11 (p. 8). The single panel is enumerated completely: panel label, title, axis label, both legend entries and the zero line; and for each of the nine rows in printed order its label, J_old and J_new (an unchanged row prints n, which is both), the grey point and 95% interval at J_old (S14b J_old column; S14b prints 'same' at J_new for an unchanged unit), the blue rescaled point and interval at J_new for the three multigraph rows (S14b J_new column) or an explicit null where no blue interval is drawn, the Holm P of each rescaled-row annotation (0.0013; the printed inequality <0.001 kept as text; 0.070), every green tick and the literal annotation. The green ticks were located on the 600-dpi rendering to within one pixel (1.5e-5 nats): each sits at the Table S11 margin on the positive axis (0.002 nats for state and MPC-RH, 0.0015 nats for radius), and products/state carries two ticks, at -0.002 and +0.002, because Table S14 prints its margin as ±0.002 for an equivalence reading. Margins are registered constants and compare at six decimals, so 0.0015 and 0.002 cannot pass for each other; effects and intervals use the five printed decimals of S14b, and the drawn grey and blue endpoints agree with them at the rendering resolution. The blue intervals are the historical analytical sensitivity of Table S14b: the two-way variance model of Note S24 with fixed means, which S14b's own record classifies as an analytical sensitivity and not an observed replication. They are compared with the generator's rescaling of the supplied J_old intervals, never with the D_confirm intervals of a newly executed or supplied confirmation campaign; those stay separate source data, and this contract does not certify that such a campaign agrees with Table S14. Notation follows the generator vocabulary (J_old, D_confirm). No target was taken from a generator output.
